title: Prepare and certify the V4 Guards 1.1.1 local composition candidate
goal: Version the P10.1 local composition contract as a uniquely identified, installed and cross-platform certified V4 Guards candidate without publishing or approving a real IFX bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: The provisional 1.1.1 version is confirmed unused before version edits; product, Host, Companion and archive identities agree while API 1.0 and unchanged component versions remain stable.
The new composition contracts are bound by the compatibility baseline and the deterministic candidate archive includes the composer, verifier and receipted installed Web Companion launcher.

The P10 synthetic test is self-contained with no external arguments for CI, is hash-bound and executed in Linux-complete and Windows-full certification, while explicit immutable-1.1.0 regression mode remains available.
An installed 1.1.1 candidate and synthetic composed sibling pass receipt, Host, Stage, query and Web Companion checks without changing the published 1.1.0 installation.
Formal Pre, exact Diff, P0/P7/P8/P9/P10 tests, Windows-full and pinned network-disabled Linux-complete certification bind one clean candidate commit and package hash.
Candidate certification records no release authorization, IFX Profile inclusion or cutover; publication and real bundle approval remain separate decisions.
